clean_body: NY City: Millions on Migrants [INSIDE JW] RECORDS SHOW RAMPANT VIOLATIONS IN MINNEAPOLIS DAYCARE CENTERS [] We received 458 pages [] of records from the Minnesota Department of Children, Youth, and Families in a Minnesota Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) request that show a strong pattern of false billing, misstated attendance records, repeated licensing violations, grant fraud, and inadequate supervision of children across multiple daycare facilities in Minneapolis. The number of violations and intentionally false reporting committed by these facilities is staggering. We obtained the records in response to our December 2025 state FOIA request. They show that the Minnesota Department of Human Services conducted video surveillance comparisons, attendance record audits, and financial grant audits that identified fraudulent billing at multiple facilities with overpayments totaling hundreds of thousands of dollars assessed, and in some cases, facilities continuing to operate and accrue new violations even after prior enforcement actions. In August 2019, the Minnesota Department of Human Services issued a Correction Order [] to the Minnesota Child Care Center, citing staff qualification deficiencies: four staff persons did not have documentation on site showing they met the education and experience requirements for their teacher job classifications. The order states “This is a repeat licensing violation. The license holder was cited for a similar violation in a Correction Order dated April 25, 2017.” Human Services in September 2019, ordered [] the Minnesota Child Care Center to pay a fine. The order states: “The Department of Human Services (DHS) is ordering you to pay a fine of $600 for three background study violations.... [Y]ou failed to request background studies for three staff persons before they began working in positions allowing direct contact with children served by your program.” Human Services issued an Administrative Disqualification and Notice of Refusal to Pay [] against Minnesota Child Care Center in August 2022, finding the center “intentionally gave materially false information on billing forms and/or provided false attendance records.” State Child Care Assistance Program payments were immediately stopped, all authorizations were closed, and the facility and its principals were disqualified from receiving Child Care Assistance Program payments for three years. A Department of Human Services investigation found significant discrepancies between video footage of children entering the building and its attendance records. In numerous 15-minute intervals across late 2018, attendance records showed children arriving when no children were observed on video. The review also found that from 2018 through 2021, the center billed for multiple holidays that did not meet Child Care Assistance Program payment criteria, often claiming both holiday pay and regular attendance on the same day. Analysis of six billing periods (November 19, 2018, through February 10, 2019) found that “361 of the 4,711 dates of [Child Care Assistance Program] billing reviewed, attendance records did not meet record keeping requirements” — including 187 missing sign-in times, 262 missing sign-out times, and 14 missing records entirely. The center was informed: What is the effect of being disqualified? In addition to being disqualified from accepting [Child Care Assistance Program] payments for three years, a disqualification may also affect your ability to clear a background study, hold a child care license or certification, have direct contact or access to children in a child care setting, and/or participate in other Department of Human Services programs. * In addition, because of the [Child Care Assistance Program] violations, we estimate Minnesota Child Care Center Inc. was overpaid $24,480.38. On August 22, 2022, a Notice of Overpayment [] was issued against Minnesota Child Care Center regarding the $24,480.38. In October 2023, Minnesota Child Care Center was ordered to pay a fine []. The order states: “The Department of Human Services (DHS) is ordering you to pay a fine of $1200 for six background study violations.” The six violations involved staff who had been working in direct contact positions without federally required enhanced background studies. In April 2024, Human Services determined that Minnesota Child Care Center failed to complete a carpet replacement project for which it received a $9,990.40 Facility Revitalization Grant in June 2022. The facility received a 90% disbursement of $8,991.36 but failed to submit the required final report with before/after photos and expense documentation by the November 30, 2022, deadline. The Notice of Overpayment [] states: You did not meet the requirements of the Facility Revitalization Grant for the March 2022 grant period as you failed to submit required project completion information and documentation by November 30, 2022. You will need to reimburse DHS for the recovery of the awarded grant money, totaling $8,991.36, for this grant period. The Minnesota Child Care Center was issued a Correction Order [] in October 2024 that cited several violations. The order noted that this was a repeat offense [] that included: Violation: Staff distribution requirements were not maintained. A teacher or assistant teacher did not directly supervise an aide. An aide was working alone with three infant-aged children. A staff person with the qualifications of a teacher was required.... Two aide qualified individuals were alone with twelve school-aged children. A staff person with the qualifications of a teacher was required.... Repeat Licensing Violation: The license holder was cited for a similar violation in the following order(s): A Correction Order dated October 31, 2023. In November 2024, Minnesota Child Care Center was ordered to pay a fine []. The order states: “The Department of Human Services (DHS) is ordering you to pay a fine of $1600 for eight background study violations.” Among the eight violations, one staff person (SP1) had a background study that expired December 31, 2022. After being ordered to remove SP1 in October 2023, the facility initiated a background study but failed to submit fingerprints within 14 days, causing the study to lapse. SP1 continued working at the center and was still present when Human Services returned in October 2024. In October 2025, the state issued a separate Notice of Overpayment [] against Minnesota Child Care Center for $9,408 for billing irregularities during December 9, 2024, to January 5, 2025 — more than two years after the facility was disqualified from the program. In December 2025, Minnesota Child Care Center was ordered [] “to pay a $200 fine for one background study violation.” The order documented a staff person (SP1), who had been employed since August 2001 and whose background study was repeatedly mishandled. An enhanced study was initiated in October 2023, but fingerprints were not submitted within 14 days, causing it to lapse. A second attempt was initiated in October 2024, but the same fingerprint submission failure occurred again. The facility had been informed three times in 2022 that enhanced studies were federally required. In August 2022, Human Services disqualified [] Nuna Child Care Center (which shared the same address as Minnesota Child Care Center) from the Child Care Assistance Program after investigators found “materially false information on billing forms and/or provided false attendance records.” Human Services cited numerous discrepancies between surveillance video of children entering the 312 W. Lake St. building and the center’s attendance records, with many instances where children were reported as arriving but were not observed on video. A review of six billing periods from November 2018 through February 2019 found: For 1,250 of the 2,055 dates of [Child Care Assistance Program] billings reviewed, attendance records did not meet record keeping requirements for one or more of the following reasons: In 18 instances, no attendance record was provided; In 1,144 instances, the attendance record were missing a time in; In 1,187 instances, attendance records were missing a time out; Billing Record Does Not Match Attendance Record: 16 In 16 instances, children were billed in attendance (Regular), but attendance records show the children marked absent or vice versa. Human Services also found improper holiday billing. A Notice of Overpayment [] for $72,529.85 was issued against Nuna Child Care Center on August 22, 2022, for the period of November 19, 2018, through February 10, 2019. In December 2024, Nuna Childcare Center was issued a Correction Order [], documenting multiple supervision failures within a single afternoon visit. The order states: Violation: Staff did not supervise the children at all times (School Age). At approximately 4:41 p.m., a child ran from the preschool classroom to the school age classroom alone.... At approximately 5:05 p.m., a child ran from the preschool classroom to the school age classroom alone.... At approximately 5:17 p.m., a teacher left three children alone in the classroom to grab something out of the lobby.... Three separate unsupervised-child incidents were observed within 36 minutes. This order was issued more than two years after Nuna’s 2022 Child Care Assistance Program disqualification, demonstrating continued operational deficiencies at the facility. In April 2023, the state issued a Notice of Overpayment [] for $47,487.80 against Mini Childcare Center for the period of November 28, 2022, through December 25, 2022. The notice states: In 709 instances, you failed to make attendance records available upon request. In 26 instances, you failed to document the time a child was signed out of care. In 27 instances, you submitted billing for children that indicated they were absent, when records indicate the children were actually present and receiving care. Human Services issued a Notice of Overpayment [] in July 2024 for $76,000 against ABC Learning Center for four Financial Hardship Grants in 2022. The center was informed it failed to “meet the requirements of the Financial Hardship Grants ... as the financial records did not reflect your claims on the Financial Hardship Grant applications. You will need to reimburse [Human Services] for the recovery of the awarded grant money ...” In November 2025, a Correction Order [] was issued against ABC Learning Center after inspectors observed children left without supervision. The order states: At approximately 3:12 p.m., the [Dept of Children, Youth and Families] licensors observed seven school aged children unsupervised in the school age classroom while a staff person walked down to the toddler and preschool classroom. Additional violations included menus that did not comply with U.S. Department of Agriculture nutritional requirements, missing written parental permissions for administering medicine, electrical outlets that were not tamper-proof or shielded, crib safety checks not conducted in 2024 and 2025, and staff training deficiencies. In June 2020, a Notice of Overpayment [] for $69,364.55 was assessed against Quality Learning Center for the period of April 22, 2019, through June 16, 2019. The notice states: In 770 instances, attendance records were not available on request. In 194 instances, the attendance records did not match the billing records. In 349 instances, the times in and/or times out were missing from attendance records. In 10 instances, the attendance records did not contain legible times in and/or out. In 940 instances, the names on attendance records did not match names on billing records. In June 2022, the state placed Quality Learning Center’s license on conditional status [] for two years, following a May 2022 inspection that found 27 violations — 10 of them repeat violations: On May 9th and May 10th, 2022, [Department of Human Services] licensors conducted a licensing review and follow-up visit at your facility located at 1411 Nicollet Ave S, Minneapolis, MN 55403. As a result of this licensing visit, the DHS licensors determined that your program failed to comply with the laws and rules that apply to licensed child care centers, citing 27 violations. DHS has considered the nature, chronicity, and severity of these violations, as well as the health, safety, and rights of children served by the program The order cites specific health and safety concerns including: Failure to comply with background study requirements (addressed in a separate Order to Pay a Fine on May 13, 2022) Failure to comply with requirements related to infant care including bottle labeling, items in a crib with an infant younger than one year of age, and crib safety inspections Failure to keep hazardous items away from children Failure to maintain adequate staff to child ratios Failure to comply with staff training requirements, including orientation, CPR, first aid, annual in-service, and child development and learning Failure to maintain children’s files Failure to maintain personnel records Failure to comply with handwashing requirements for children In September 2022, the state issued a Correction Order [] against Sweet Angel Child Care, citing 25 licensing violations. The violations spanned staffing, supervision, recordkeeping, facility safety, training, infant care, and emergency preparedness requirements. Among other violations the order notes, “The DHS licensor observed the school age staff person leave sixteen children in the classroom unsupervised when another child left the classroom and ran out into the hallway.” In May 2023, the state issued a Notice of Overpayment [] of $9,830.80 against Sweet Angel Child Care for the period of December 12, 2022, through January 8, 2023. Officials designated March 20, a previously scheduled noninstructional day, as a snow makeup day and Muslim groups, led by CAIR, immediately waved the discrimination card and the Maryland public school district reversed course. name: Danielle Bethell for Governor
subject: Salem Failed Us. Again.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Danielle Bethell PAC 20220 [Preferences](https://daniellebethell
body:
HB 4106 was a practical fix to close a real gap in law that is hurting real people.
[](https://daniellebethell.cmail19.com/t/y-l-atjijuk-hhlrhljhit-r/) Friends,The Legislature failed us.HB 4106 would have filled a critical gap in Oregon law and given counties clearer authority to respond to individuals experiencing serious mental health crises. Instead, lawmakers let it stall -- leaving the same broken system in place.As a County Commissioner and the local mental health authority in one of Oregon's largest counties, I deal with the consequences of these failures every day.This legislation would have been a real solution to real problems.
* It's deputies and first responders trying to help someone in crisis without the legal clarity they need.
* It's families desperate for intervention options that don't currently exist.
* It's vulnerable individuals cycling through emergency rooms, jails, and short-term holds because the system lacks the structure to truly stabilize them.

HB 4106 was a practical fix to close a real gap in law that is hurting real people. If you want a Governor who's ready to stand up and fight against the usual go-along-to-get-along insider games, I'm ready to get the job done. [Visit My Website](https://daniellebethell.cmail19.com/t/y-l-atjijuk-hhlrhljhit-y/) For years, Salem has talked about behavioral health reform. We've had task forces. We've had roundtables. We've had press conferences. But when it came time to advance a bill that would actually strengthen crisis response at the local level, lawmakers failed to act.Compassion requires more than talking points.
Leadership requires follow-through.Oregon's behavioral health system is strained, fragmented, and too often reactive instead of proactive. Counties are doing everything we can to hold it together, but we cannot fix structural gaps in state law from the local level.That requires executive leadership.I'm running for Governor because I've worked inside this system. I understand where it breaks down. I understand the legal and operational gaps. And I know that reform takes more than policy language -- it takes accountability and the willingness to make hard decisions.Oregon deserves a Governor who won't ignore the cracks in the system when they become politically inconvenient.We deserve leadership that closes those gaps.--
Danielle Bethell
Republican for Governor
Marion County Commissioner [Donate Today](https://daniellebethell.cmail19.com/t/y-l-atjijuk-hhlrhljhit-j/) [Visit My Website](https://daniellebethell.cmail19.com/t/y-l-atjijuk-hhlrhljhit-t/) [](https://daniellebethell.cmail19.com/t/y-l-atjijuk-hhlrhljhit-i/)[](https://daniellebethell.cmail19.com/t/y-l-atjijuk-hhlrhljhit-d/)[](https://daniellebethell.cmail19.com/t/y-l-atjijuk-hhlrhljhit-h/)[](https://daniellebethell.cmail19.com/t/y-l-atjijuk-hhlrhljhit-k/) | [ Share ](https://daniellebethell.cmail19.com/t/y-fb-atjijuk-hhlrhljhit-x/) | [ Tweet ](https://daniellebethell.cmail19.com/t/y-tw-atjijuk-hhlrhljhit-m/) | [ Share ](https://daniellebethell.cmail19.com/t/y-li-atjijuk-hhlrhljhit-c/) | [ Forward ](https://daniellebethell.forwardtomyfriend.com/y-hhlrhljhit-E19159AE-atjijuk-l-q)

subject: You don’t hear this enough, Peter

body:
Dear Peter,

This is something you don’t hear very often in politics: thank you.

Truly. Thank you.

Because of you, we’ve been able to hold the line in Nevada. Together, we stopped massive tax hikes. We vetoed extreme legislation coming out of Carson City. We protected parents’ rights. We stood up for public safety and backed the men and women in uniform. We’ve worked to grow jobs, bring businesses to Nevada, and keep our state competitive.

None of that happens without you.

Now we’re facing our end-of-month deadline at midnight, and I’d be honored to have your support again. [https://secure.winred.com/lombardo-for-governor/022626_eom_halombardo/?utm_source=Housefile&utm_medium=HA-Email&utm_campaign=02.26.26_EOM_HALombardo&utm_content=Link&recurring=true]

SEND IN YOUR SUPPORT BEFORE MIDNIGHT [https://secure.winred.com/lombardo-for-governor/022626_eom_halombardo/?utm_source=Housefile&utm_medium=HA-Email&utm_campaign=02.26.26_EOM_HALombardo&utm_content=Link&recurring=true]

The next four years are on the line.

If Democrats regain full power, we know exactly what comes next: higher taxes, fewer jobs, more crime, and a radical social agenda that puts politics ahead of parents and common sense. Four years of unchecked control in Carson City would send Nevada down the same road as California.

I won’t let that happen.

If we’re going to pass real, common-sense reforms, we need Republican majorities in Carson City. We need a firewall against the woke California agenda that’s always trying to creep across our border.

And let me be clear about something else.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. ## Trump Bans Anthropic AI After Military Dispute
President Trump on Friday ordered all federal agencies [to immediately stop using Anthropic's AI](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGunDAQRb8GOq_sMWBTuIgUbfeidCnRYGaXSYyN7HlvtX8fkV9IfXSv7j2_PpYP5MT5-QMPCvIoS6ZXSyRCdcGDKkfEvHGrSKlJ5T_EFRfQMCkNCvyyIaf3MvRbeBAB2Z6CcQ7ATc76fg9uhsmMNE4e3Ap21XaYB7PGNQL4TZuew9WmAbwxerTTzWiH6CnOs416dNQNmjaWUm-_C2fZ6ZHe5YvqLZajT2EXOVtnv3Vw7-COa7weXKyD-8-SWDi2C2TZazk5qoRCTdRJWfBZsoolS8UoasWqkBV-SsnlKJ9NvQjPkq94k1Lfnb3z1tnvxupx9H72fQ3b-eKUuE2uG_TzQE7_dsl_yfwK8DcAAP__iVyJMw) technology, bringing an apparent end to a months-long dispute between the Pentagon and the company over military use of its systems. # She Needs Your Protection.
---
|

If you’re the kind of man who _thinks_ he’s protecting his family... read this. Because there’s a moment you can’t control. It’s not the moment you’re at work. Or stuck in traffic. Or asleep in bed. It’s the moment she’s alone. Parking lot. Gas station. Apartment stairwell. Store entrance. Campus path. A “quick run” that turns into a life-changing nightmare in under 10 seconds. And here’s the sick truth: Predators don’t go looking for a “fight.” They go looking for **easy**. A woman with her hands full. Head down. Keys out. Phone glowing. Not expecting it. They don’t need much time. They need **one** moment where she’s unprepared...and you’re not there. And if you think, “That won’t happen to us...” That’s what _every_ man says right up until he’s sitting in a hospital chair at 2:14 a.m. Staring at his phone. Trying to figure out how the hell he didn’t do more. Because once it happens... you don’t get to rewind it. You don’t get to negotiate with it. You don’t get to “wish” it didn’t happen. You get to live with it. So I’m going to ask you a brutal question: **If someone grabs her today... what does she have?** Not what you _hope_ she’ll do. Not what she _should_ do. What does she have in her hands — **right now** — that creates an escape window? Because “be careful” doesn’t stop a wrist grab. A “call me when you get there” doesn’t stop a man who’s already decided. And “keys between your knuckles” is mostly a movie myth. Here’s what actually changes outcomes: A **force multiplier**. Something that creates chaos, noise, pain, confusion...and buys her a few seconds to run. **Overnight (or morning in Israel and Iran), President Donald Trump delivered a speech on TruthSocial and described the Iranian regime as:**
**" A vicious group of very hard, terrible people whose menacing activities have directly endangered the United States, our troops, our bases overseas, and our allies throughout the world."**
**President Trump noted that for 47 years Iran has chanted "Death to America," targeted U.S. forces, and backed terror across the region -- beginning with the 1979 U.S. Embassy takeover in Tehran, where Americans were held hostage for 444 days.**
**The President said Iran was offered diplomacy: end its nuclear ambitions, limit ballistic missiles, and stop supporting proxy militias. "They had an out -- and they didn't take it," he said, calling the current campaign "massive and ongoing."**
**Israel remains under ballistic missile attack. Sirens have sounded in Tel Aviv, Jerusalem, and across the country and I have been getting reports and videos live.**
**Most incoming missiles are reportedly being intercepted.**
**Israel is mobilizing 70,000 reservists as it prepares for sustained attacks in the days ahead as it prepares for a long term battle.**
**A Broad Military Campaign**
**U.S. and Israeli forces are striking:**
**• Missile launch sites**
**• Command centers**
**• Government infrastructure**
**• IRGC leadership targets**
**Close coordination between Washington and Jerusalem is described as unprecedented.**
**It should be interesting to see how American lawmakers respond, likely on partisan lines, as to whether this was a legal attack and whether Israelis violated any international law. There is at least one lone wolf and it is not surprising that it is Senator John Fetterman.**

**Regional Retaliation**
**Iran is responding well beyond Israel -- targeting or threatening U.S. positions in Bahrain and across the Gulf.**
**It is possible that regional proxies such as Hezbollah could join the conflict.**
**The U.S. has deployed major naval assets, including the USS Gerald R. Ford and USS Abraham Lincoln carrier strike groups -- This is the largest regional buildup since 2003.**
**This is a Regional War**
**Missiles continue. Forces are mobilized. The risk of American casualties is real and fully recognized by President Trump as necessary to save future generations from the imminent nuclear threat of Iran.**
**The stated objective: to eliminate Iran 's ability to threaten the region and U.S. allies.**
**The coming days will determine whether this conflict remains contained -- or expands further.**
**President Trump gave Iranian troops the option that if they laid down their weapons they would be granted immunity.**
**To Iranians he issued the following: - **_**" The hour of your freedom is at hand"**_**and urging the people of Iran to seize control of their government as this was a historic opportunity and would not happen again.**
**This is an ever changing situation.**

## Trump Visits Texas to Tout Energy Plans
President [Trump visited Texas](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuqzAQRL_GdEb24hhSuHgNXV57S2TjJaxkcGQ2Ifz9FfzC7UYa6YzO_DyGh6dE6_O_X9Dxd8rDivuWkBnLwOW9vD60EU-FcI3pmKhgzPsACqxUIKEboqd0DKaKLqh41xU63bYAnQJoqtnpGKYQvBoDTPGONjRN1wZlvPX3VltbkTthCqDToBoDtQ3QYWts7G7NDZQWRmEkzqXmGRm_fpvSkT9Y6jEvVXIz82sTzT8BvYB-3_f68HPOZyugP3UE9L4wjQnPeFlJzm-WOOY1L4fEFcvzkBdcaq0AjL7ZeuYlVcXF104p0WZbYdRz8ZSuZf7bXx8HvwEAAP__H6KAew) yesterday in his first trip since the State of the Union address and amid tight GOP races in next week's state primaries. Trump touted the strength of the state economy and its growth in the energy market in his address in Corpus Christi, saying he was looking to Texas to spearhead growth in the nation's oil production. During his address, Trump did not endorse a candidate in Texas' highly-publicized GOP primary for U.S. Senate, though [all three candidates showed up](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkTGupDAQRE8DWSO7AdsEBJuQ_U03RAY3n9YaG5me4c_tVzNX2KxUJT3pqf58zV-eI6fv3_6gUX62PCe6r0giVGYpj-N88sWyFaYU4mvjQiHfMyo0oBDQzcFzfM1dHcZFhUHXNGprEZ1CbOt97GgZfBd8PwRLriX0g1u2Vfc2aNRmq3l8wxSi06jaDhuzoCPbmeD6tkelq05RYMmlkZ2Efvy1xVd-UmnWfNRx3EXOq2p_VThVON333fwVSu-xwultU-F05sjC6ztelLwQfOcTVp8CBy90ASf4oKH4GF9ws-zw0YflIRDJP-lT5oeAT0Ap5HLRQUkqnHwRXiPNNDi0ZkBQy2KgN4jgnNMwtFZrR7Y36JtdjliXMZw3x8iXsVWnvg_P8aMj_3fCc8R_AQAA__8eyZyu) at the event: Incumbent John Cornyn, Attorney General Ken Paxton, and Rep. Wesley Hunt. Trump said earlier this month on Air Force One that, _" You're supposed to pick one, so we'll see what happens. But I support [all three](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFuwyAUheGngY0IXzCQgaGLt3TtaJFwbV8JjIVpEr99Fb9C5yN90n9-buMtUKJ1_g4ZfXtPZVzxtSdsDevY6m_enrRTmyrhGtMxUcVYXiNIMEKCADfGQOkYNY_-LuO14-g7awGcBFB88dG4Xjql8BqmoB8RLCitYpBGaY195OQ_mARwHUil4WLu4NBqE12vepAd0xIjtVIvbcGG77BP6ShPrJdHyTz5pbVtZ-qLwcBgaAsulNJnYzAsJeMniMHwCHkLNK8Mht721uhOnH3iJMWOa2go5rKJrVIO9WAw8Orj9qKUaDeWaTnnQCfN2__Oenr4CwAA__-M335r)."_
## Education Board to Fix Bible-Based Curriculum
Texas’ State Board of Education approved an update to its optional [Bible-infused](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2uqzAQBOCnMR2RWRvbKVzchi63PSUyeB1WMjgyS37e_oi8wqlH80kzP7fxFijTdv8fVvT8TmXc8LVnZMY6cj3Wx5N24lQJt5g_iSrG8hpBgmkltODGGCh_Rt1EP8l47Rr0nbUATgKoZvGd66PuLabYGW2UCZNLakIbo1HJXUND_sQkgOtAKg0XM4FDq010vepBdkJLjMSlXnhBxnfYU_6UJ9bLXNYm-4X5sQv1T8AgYOAFF8r5zAQMS1nxHCRgwHjMgalsAobe9lepXfvV2ommjO181ErzkY-1xVpLPTtN9fHxopxpN1ZoeV8DfemG_3bW08NvAAAA__8cH38Y) public school curriculum, known as “Bluebonnet Learning,” after over 4,000 errors were reported. A Texas Education Agency spokesman suggested that the reported number of errors was exaggerated due to the reporting system counting the same issues multiple times, and that the actual number of issues was less than 2,000. The Board also said that most of the errors were grammatical instead of factual, but one member warned that "even if it is a typo, it can become an [error of fact](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHOozAQBOCnMZ0jsxhjChfX0P3XXolsvCQrGYzshSRvf0pe4a9H82k0_37mH0-J9vtfv6Hj15rnHZ81ITOWmcu5HRdV4rUQ7jG9VyoY83MGBUYqkGDn6Cm9Z91EF1Qc2wZdOwwAVgF0zcOFCL0dF2uwhXUZe9-PBgbfBaO1UR005D6YArAtqE7DzQSwOGgTbd_1oFqhFUbiXG78QMaXr2t65wvLbclbk9yD-aii-yNgEjD5sLTdJxEwHbmygOnbkSH7EiXGc_FMeZf-OEq-sEoNSsnziJ6xypVeWGVIJ4a878hyOUuh5UznB2yt6fU4WAFTU1w8npQSVTMIre6bp_RdxL_78XLwPwAA___bUYch).” Around 300 Texas school districts said they planned to use the Bluebonnet curriculum when it was introduced last year.
## Border Protection Drone Shot Down over Texas
A Customs and Border Protection drone was [shot down](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u3CAQRp8Gd6zGA2uTgiJS5G7TRFFKC8OwRsLGgtkfv3209xVu_Umfzjn_bvPNpZz2-2-3keV3LPNOr5aJmerM9bEdz9QSx5poD_mMqVIorxkBBwko0czBpXzOugt2gfCj78j244hoAFF1q4VFgfcAQIMadPTeaadUgKBiXIzxXbKfM0A0PYLSeBkWNDTqIZiruiL0QgOFxKVeeCWmt2sxn-VJ9eLL1mW7Mh9NqJ8CJ4GTW_zH4LMJnP7-ETgFOlgGirQ3km0thZv0j8Zla3IpNVCVRy1MnlPZZahlJ0lZ4NS41FOoKQWhfvUKrtqMYLpqw_FKOac2jELDfXMpf7Hw9wo-Lf4PAAD__wTyhjA) near El Paso this week in a case of friendly fire, as the Department of War deployed a counter-unmanned aircraft system when personnel couldn’t identify the nature of the drone. The incident resulted in the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) expanding its [temporary flight restrictions](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuqzAQRL8GOpBZiG0KF6-hy2tviUy8DisZjOxNHP7-ivzC7UYa6Yzm_Nznu6VA-_O_3dDwx8d5x5IDMmOaOb22402Z2CfC3YXTU0IXywwCZCOgAT07S-Gch9qZRbixq9F0SgFoAdDXq8FB4ej1uMCixehhlIigwPn-5qVcVE3mggkA3YHoB2jlAhrVIJ2-9TcQXTUIdMQxtbwi48dmH874xtQ-4lYHszIfuer_VTBVMJVS2tOuMV5tBdN1p4LJJqZHwCt6a5u8vjg3Lpa9sZTyYR_YfNGN6MXQKwWqXXkLdTLuKBQCZamqQTw3S-G7y3-z9TbwGwAA__91_375) around Fort Hancock, but the FAA has noted that the restrictions don’t apply to commercial aircraft. Congressional Democrats on the House Aviation Committee criticized the incident, saying they asked the White House to “address the lack of coordination” between Homeland Security, the FAA, and the Pentagon months ago. The drone was shot down in a remote area, and no one was injured, according to the Department of War.

I have to say it...

The campus climate this spring?

_It 's been downright ugly._

To be frank, the Left has never made it easy for our students. That's always come with the territory when you're speaking truth deep in the belly of the beast...

But this semester is different.

**This has been one of the most hostile semesters Turning Point USA students have ever faced. **

From coast to coast, high school and college students who dared to stand for faith, freedom, and this great nation have been stalked, slandered, threatened, and in some cases -- _physically attacked. _

All for saying what you and I know to be true:

That America is worth defending. That speech must remain free. And that Charlie Kirk's life and legacy meant something.

And despite the opposition -- our students didn't back down.

They didn't run. They didn't hide.

They showed up -- earlier, louder, and stronger than ever before.

_But not without cost. _

**Let me tell you more about what our students have been up against so far this year... **

In Maryland, one of our high school leaders -- just 17 years old -- helped organize a Club America event on campus back in December.

It was peaceful. Students only. Parental permission required. No outside adults. Everything done by the book.

And yet, weeks later, during a recent local school board meeting...

A local woman stood up and publicly accused this student of "grooming children."

Then she went even further.

She told the board: _" All members of this Board are mandatory reporters... Based on the circumstances surrounding this event, **a report was made to Child Protective Services. " **_

Yes, you read that right -- she weaponized CPS against one of our students.

Filed against a **minor. **

For organizing a pro-America Turning Point USA event with his friends.

Now, I want you to imagine being 17 years old... doing everything right... following every rule... showing up with courage and conviction...

And then hearing a stranger stand up in front of your entire community and imply that you're a danger to children.

That you need to be investigated. That you're the problem.

_**Above:** "Nancy" -- the Leftist Karen who filed a CPS report against a local Club America chapter and spoke out against them at a recent school board meeting. _
---
How would _you_ respond?

Because I'll tell you what he did...

He walked up to that microphone -- calm, steady, unshaken -- and said:

_" We have been accused of many things... I'm the president of the group. I'm 17, I'm a minor. I can't groom children because I am a child." _

Seventeen years old. Standing alone. But standing strong in front of his entire community while facing outrageous, malicious accusations.

That's courage. The kind of courage Charlie would've been proud of.

And that courage is catching fire across the country. _But so is the hatred. _

Because what happened in Maryland wasn't an isolated incident... It's just the beginning:

🚨 **At Lawrence University in Wisconsin, Leftists on campus are trying to permanently shut down a brand-new TPUSA chapter before it even starts. **

Never mind that Lawrence has over 160 student clubs... and not one is right-leaning. Or that the university handbook bans discrimination based on political affiliation.

One of our students there is now receiving death threats.

And instead of protecting him?

The Left-wing student government is putting the chapter's fate up to a campus-wide vote.

🚨 **At Iowa State University, **Colby Brandt -- the student body president -- was threatened with _**impeachment**_ because he had connections to TPUSA. Fortunately, his "impeachment" was dismissed by the student government's judicial branch... But this was only after the outrage that followed on social media and the university's administration came to its senses.

| Letter from the Chair
---
Our Nation Is Back: Bigger, Better, Richer, and Stronger Than Ever Before
These stirring words from President Trump's 2026 State of the Union address captured the energy surging through America right now.
A true revival is underway--one that goes far beyond politics. We're witnessing a spiritual awakening, with younger generations flocking to churches in search of timeless tradition and unapologetic orthodoxy. At the same time, a powerful resurgence of patriotism is uniting us as we approach the 250th anniversary of the Signing of the Declaration of Independence in 2026. This milestone isn't just a date on the calendar--it's a celebration of American greatness that will carry us forward with pride and purpose.
President Trump's speech embodied this renewed patriotic fervor, a stark contrast to the subdued tones of recent State of the Union addresses. He boldly celebrated America's exceptionalism and the everyday heroism of its people, reminding us of what makes this country extraordinary.
A particularly moving thread ran through the address: deep respect for mothers. Trump honored:

* Working mothers who power our economy and families every day
* Grieving mothers who have endured unimaginable loss, including those like Anya Zarutska, whose daughter Iryna was tragically taken--highlighting the human cost of failed policies
* Mothers fighting fiercely for their children's safety, futures, and well-being such as Michele Blair who fought against the secret social transitioning her daughter Sage by Virginia school officials.

He spotlighted policies that resonate strongly with everyday Americans, policies that put citizens first:

* The SAVE Act to secure elections and protect the integrity of our vote
* Banning commercial driver's licenses (CDLs) for illegal aliens to enhance road safety (as embodied in proposals like the Dalilah Law)
* Investing in our children's futures through targeted support and opportunity
* Ensuring no new AI data centers drive up electric bills for hardworking families
* Ending insider trading in Congress to restore trust in government
* Prioritizing protection for American citizens over illegal immigrants

Throughout the evening, Democrats remained seated--refusing to stand for these pro-American priorities, for grieving families, or for the promise of a secure and prosperous future.
As John Solomon so aptly put it, the speech drew a clear line in the sand: between the Patriots who cheer America's comeback and the Hatriots who sit in defiance.
This is more than a moment--it's a movement. Our nation is reclaiming its strength, its faith, and its pride. Let's keep building on this momentum as we head toward our historic 250th birthday and the 2026 elections!

clean_body: News, events, and action items to keep Nebraska red and growing strong. | | | | | | Letter from the Chair Our Nation Is Back: Bigger, Better, Richer, and Stronger Than Ever Before These stirring words from President Trump's 2026 State of the Union address captured the energy surging through America right now. A true revival is underway--one that goes far beyond politics. We're witnessing a spiritual awakening, with younger generations flocking to churches in search of timeless tradition and unapologetic orthodoxy. At the same time, a powerful resurgence of patriotism is uniting us as we approach the 250th anniversary of the Signing of the Declaration of Independence in 2026. This milestone isn't just a date on the calendar--it's a celebration of American greatness that will carry us forward with pride and purpose. President Trump's speech embodied this renewed patriotic fervor, a stark contrast to the subdued tones of recent State of the Union addresses. He boldly celebrated America's exceptionalism and the everyday heroism of its people, reminding us of what makes this country extraordinary. A particularly moving thread ran through the address: deep respect for mothers. Trump honored: Working mothers who power our economy and families every day Grieving mothers who have endured unimaginable loss, including those like Anya Zarutska, whose daughter Iryna was tragically taken--highlighting the human cost of failed policies Mothers fighting fiercely for their children's safety, futures, and well-being such as Michele Blair who fought against the secret social transitioning her daughter Sage by Virginia school officials. He spotlighted policies that resonate strongly with everyday Americans, policies that put citizens first: The SAVE Act to secure elections and protect the integrity of our vote Banning commercial driver's licenses (CDLs) for illegal aliens to enhance road safety (as embodied in proposals like the Dalilah Law) Investing in our children's futures through targeted support and opportunity Ensuring no new AI data centers drive up electric bills for hardworking families Ending insider trading in Congress to restore trust in government * Prioritizing protection for American citizens over illegal immigrants Throughout the evening, Democrats remained seated--refusing to stand for these pro-American priorities, for grieving families, or for the promise of a secure and prosperous future. As John Solomon so aptly put it, the speech drew a clear line in the sand: between the Patriots who cheer America's comeback and the Hatriots who sit in defiance. This is more than a moment--it's a movement. Our nation is reclaiming its strength, its faith, and its pride. Let's keep building on this momentum as we head toward our historic 250th birthday and the 2026 elections! Friend,
When an administration encourages a rogue enforcement force to abuse power, it threatens our elections, our communities, and our Constitution. _Americans want safety, not Trump chaos._
If we do not stand up against this lawlessness that we see this administration engaging in, then what is left for us?

Peter — As Black History Month draws to a close, I’ve been reflecting on the extraordinary courage it took for Black Americans to build this country, sustain its promise, and — generation after generation — demand that America live up to its ideals. That fight unfolded in courtrooms, at polling places, and in communities across Florida. From the injustice faced by the Groveland Four to the civil rights organizers who demanded fair wages and equal protection under the law, Black Floridians have long stood at the forefront of holding power accountable. That history is inseparable from the work of the Attorney General. The right to vote. The right to equal protection. The right to be free from fraud and exploitation. These rights were fought for. And they endure only when the law is enforced fairly and without fear or favor. It is an honor to attend the South Dade Democratic Black Caucus Black History Month Celebration — a reminder that this legacy of leadership and resilience is very much alive. Black history in Florida isn’t just something we commemorate. It’s a responsibility we carry forward. And as your next Attorney General, I intend to carry it with integrity, fairness, and courage. clean_body: The fight for justice never stops. | Peter — As Black History Month draws to a close, I’ve been reflecting on the extraordinary courage it took for Black Americans to build this country, sustain its promise, and — generation after generation — demand that America live up to its ideals. That fight unfolded in courtrooms, at polling places, and in communities across Florida. From the injustice faced by the Groveland Four to the civil rights organizers who demanded fair wages and equal protection under the law, Black Floridians have long stood at the forefront of holding power accountable. That history is inseparable from the work of the Attorney General. The right to vote. The right to equal protection. The right to be free from fraud and exploitation. These rights were fought for. And they endure only when the law is enforced fairly and without fear or favor. It is an honor to attend the South Dade Democratic Black Caucus Black History Month Celebration — a reminder that this legacy of leadership and resilience is very much alive. Black history in Florida isn’t just something we commemorate. It’s a responsibility we carry forward. And as your next Attorney General, I intend to carry it with integrity, fairness, and courage. It’s Josh Turek, the Democrat running to replace Republican Joni Ernst in Iowa’s U.S. Senate race.
Friend, I’m going to be brutally honest: Iowa is at rock bottom.
Our farmers are defaulting on mortgages and struggling to make a living.
Over 200K people have either lost their health insurance, or will have to cough up twice as much money to cover their premiums.
We have the fastest-growing cancer rate in America, the 49th in economic growth, and the 48th in wage growth.
Our so-called leaders want us to ignore what’s happening in front of our eyes.
Frankly, if we can’t win Iowa in _this_ political environment, we’ve lost it for a generation.
I know that sounds pessimistic, but actually I’m feeling more optimistic than I have in a long, long time. The energy I’m seeing in every nook and cranny of the state is higher than it was than the blue wave of 2018.

Our farmers are defaulting on mortgages and struggling to make a living. Over 200K people have either lost their health insurance, or will have to cough up twice as much money to cover their premiums. We have the fastest-growing cancer rate in America, the 49th in economic growth, and the 48th in wage growth. Our so-called leaders want us to ignore what’s happening in front of our eyes. Frankly, if we can’t win Iowa in this political environment, we’ve lost it for a generation. I know that sounds pessimistic, but actually I’m feeling more optimistic than I have in a long, long time. #

Dear friends,
I am reaching out to you to respectfully ask if you can [**donate $10 to GIFFORDS PAC before our February deadline expires at midnight.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q12026.IDrYd1&refcode=em260228-1-b&t=1&akid=11284%2E3935704%2EReBzWC)
We knew that when Donald Trump was elected, there would be challenges ahead. Now, we are seeing firsthand that Donald Trump and the MAGA-right are wasting no time in trying to reverse our hard-earned gun safety progress.
In one of their first acts in office, the Trump administration abolished the White House Office of Gun Violence Prevention.
Now, we are hearing reports that the House GOP is preparing to pass legislation for a nationwide concealed carry mandate — which could happen in a matter of weeks.
**The challenges we’re up against won’t be easy. But I know a thing or two about getting through tough times.**
I was shot in 2011, and I have been on a recovery journey every day since then. Some days are harder than others, but even on the most difficult days, I refuse to give up hope.
It’s the same way I refuse to give up hope for our gun violence prevention movement, even in these moments of uncertainty.
I will be fighting each and every day for a future free from gun violence, just as I have since GIFFORDS’ founding 13 years ago.
[**Can I count on you to stand by me in this fight? clean_body: Dear friends, I am reaching out to you to respectfully ask if you can We knew that when Donald Trump was elected, there would be challenges ahead. Now, we are seeing firsthand that Donald Trump and the MAGA-right are wasting no time in trying to reverse our hard-earned gun safety progress. In one of their first acts in office, the Trump administration abolished the White House Office of Gun Violence Prevention. Now, we are hearing reports that the House GOP is preparing to pass legislation for a nationwide concealed carry mandate — which could happen in a matter of weeks. The challenges we’re up against won’t be easy. But I know a thing or two about getting through tough times. I was shot in 2011, and I have been on a recovery journey every day since then. Some days are harder than others, but even on the most difficult days, I refuse to give up hope. It’s the same way I refuse to give up hope for our gun violence prevention movement, even in these moments of uncertainty. I will be fighting each and every day for a future free from gun violence, just as I have since GIFFORDS’ founding 13 years ago. ### The greatest threat to socialism is ownership.
Charlie Kirk understood this better than anyone in American politics, and his tragically shortened life was devoted to a simple but revolutionary idea: if you want young Americans to reject socialism, don't lecture them about Karl Marx. Give them a stake in capitalism. Make them owners. Show them that the system works not just for the already wealthy, but for anyone willing to save, invest, and bet on America's future.
Before his assassination in September, Kirk had accomplished something remarkable. He helped engineer the largest generational shift toward conservative economics in decades, with Donald Trump seeing a 7-point increase in support among voters under 30 between 2020 and 2024--the biggest jump of any age group. That didn't happen because Kirk won a viral debate. It happened because he offered young people something tangible: a path to prosperity through ownership, investment, and entrepreneurship, rather than the socialist fantasy of equal misery for all.

# [Keep Charlie's Mission Alive!](https://substack.com/redirect/428c0eb9-e6ef-4ca7-8d8b-76de7fda069e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
## **We 're Not Waiting Until Election Day!**
We're on the ground in the districts and states that will decide Congress and the future of our America First movement. We're registering voters, recruiting precinct leaders, and chasing ballots in Arizona, Georgia, Wisconsin, Pennsylvania, Michigan, Nevada, and North Carolina -- right now.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/428c0eb9-e6ef-4ca7-8d8b-76de7fda069e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**This is how we win. Not in the 11th hour. Not with last-minute ads. But with relentless, early, precinct-by-precinct work that turns conservative energy into counted votes.**
_Democrats are hoping we wait. We 're not giving them that chance._
Your support today funds the chasers, the tech, and the maps that are already moving across the country.

We're building the biggest America First ground operation ever. Let's make sure it's unstoppable.
[Keep TPUSA's Mission Alive](https://substack.com/redirect/428c0eb9-e6ef-4ca7-8d8b-76de7fda069e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
_**(Piece continues below)**_
Kirk's signature message was disarmingly straightforward: "Always bet on America!" It was a philosophy. He preached aggressive investment in index funds, boldly buying market dips during panic, and viewing American capitalism not as an obstacle to wealth but as the single greatest wealth-creation engine in human history. He told young people to skip overpriced college degrees that led nowhere, start businesses, learn trades, and most importantly, become investors--stakeholders with skin in the game.
This was not abstract theory. Kirk practiced what he preached, investing 75 to 80 percent of everything he earned and taking no salary from Turning Point USA for five years. He talked about buying triple-leveraged Nasdaq funds during the COVID crash when everyone else was panicking. His reasoning was: this country doesn't stay down. If you believe in the system, you invest in it when it's on sale.
The contrast with the socialist left's messaging couldn't be any clearer. The religion of envy that animates far-left economic ideology offers young people exactly one thing: resentment. It teaches them that success is theft, that wealth is immoral, that anyone who has more than you got it by exploiting you. It is a philosophy of victimhood, and its only policy prescriptions involve taking from the successful and redistributing to the resentful. It doesn't build. It doesn't create. It devours.
Kirk's alternative was aspirational, not accusatory. He championed policies like President Trump's proposal to create $1,000 investment accounts for every newborn American--a revolutionary idea that would make every child a stakeholder in the market from day one. Parents and grandparents could contribute. The account would grow, compounding over 18 years, teaching financial literacy and the power of long-term investment. By the time these children turned 18, they would have a considerable nest egg to spend on school, buying a home or starting a business. They would have spent their entire lives watching capitalism work in their favor.
* * *
# The left cannot stop us!
## Your contribution will make a difference
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/428c0eb9-e6ef-4ca7-8d8b-76de7fda069e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Keep TPUSA's Mission Alive](https://substack.com/redirect/428c0eb9-e6ef-4ca7-8d8b-76de7fda069e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
This is how you inoculate a generation against socialism. Not by demonizing the poor or dismissing legitimate grievances about housing costs and wage stagnation, but by creating structures that turn renters into owners, employees into entrepreneurs, and bystanders into investors. Kirk knew that a 25-year-old with a portfolio, a mortgage, and equity in a business thinks very differently about redistribution than a 25-year-old with student debt, high rent, and no assets. The former has something to protect and grow. The latter has nothing to lose.
The answer is not to abandon free markets. It is to ensure that free markets remain accessible. Lower the barriers to homeownership. Promote alternatives to crippling student debt. Encourage investment and savings. Celebrate wealth creation rather than demonizing the successful. Teach young Americans that capitalism isn't a rigged game for elites--it's the most powerful tool for upward mobility ever devised, and it belongs to anyone willing to participate.
Charlie Kirk spent his life making that case, and it's important that we carry his torch forward into the new American century.

body:
We are not where we need to be.

| | | Peter,

Today is the final day of February and we are just hours away from our deadline.

We are not where we need to be.

Republicans are already spending in districts like ours and preparing to flip this seat. They are lining up behind Anthony D’Esposito again.

The same Anthony D’Esposito who was named one of the most corrupt members of Congress. The same Anthony D’Esposito who was exposed for giving his mistress a taxpayer-funded no-show job.

They want a tiebreaker rematch. But Laura’s beat him once and she’ll do it again.

That's not who my opponent is. In God I Trust: Making Our National Motto My Personal Declaration, is available at the link below. I am honored to have created it alongside my pastor and friend, Brad Wells.
| [ Buy "In God I Trust"](https://eufi5.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeFuBmP64SPACXkt7Xr7g/QEy2p6pOqK4a)
---
**_Our national motto was relevant in 1776, 1814, 1864, and it’s still relevant today!_**
In God We Trust!
In this book, General Teichert and Pastor Wells carefully follow the unbroken national lineage of our powerful motto. But it doesn’t stop there! It provides a practical roadmap to guide a spiritual journey designed to make that motto personal.
In God I Trust!
It’s not just academic history. It’s individual hierarchy. And God must be at the top!
In God I Trust is woven together to celebrate our nation’s 250th birthday, while highlighting the threads that lead towards national and personal revival. In the United States of America, it’s long past time to make the national motto our personal declaration.
Lieutenant General (ret) Jerry Boykin, Executive Vice President of the Family Research Council says the following:
“In God I Trust is the perfect book for such a time as this in the United States of America! It carefully explains the unbroken lineage of our national motto while diligently guiding the reader through a journey to make that motto personal. As we celebrate our great nation’s 250th birthday, it fervently points us back to a spirit of national dependency and personal reliance on the Lord our God. Especially during this semiquincentennial year, every American should read these words of history and spiritual direction while determining to make the national motto our own personal declaration.”
Thanks for checking it out, and rating, reviewing, and sharing to your network! If you are interested in bulk discounts and specials, please reach out directly.

* John

Peter, President Trump’s State of the Union speech wasn’t filled with as many insults and political attacks as we’ve become accustomed to, and that’s a positive. But the remarks we heard still lacked the policy focus and seriousness Americans need right now.

The President largely stuck to a highlight reel of the good news, while not really addressing the tougher issues the country is facing, including national security and foreign policy. With U.S. military assets deployed in the Middle East, tensions rising with Iran, Ukraine’s future and America’s role, he said very little, offering neither a clear commitment nor a clear strategy.

The Trump administration owes the American people an explanation about what our goals are in these conflicts. There needs to be a clearly defined strategy about what will define success and how we will get our brave men and women home.

I promised you that I would do my best to offer context and clarity you don’t often find elsewhere, grounded insight that helps make sense of what’s actually happening in the world and why it matters.

clean_body: Grounded expert insight that helps make sense of what’s actually happening in the world and why it matters.| | | Peter, President Trump’s State of the Union speech wasn’t filled with as many insults and political attacks as we’ve become accustomed to, and that’s a positive. But the remarks we heard still lacked the policy focus and seriousness Americans need right now. The President largely stuck to a highlight reel of the good news, while not really addressing the tougher issues the country is facing, including national security and foreign policy. With U.S. military assets deployed in the Middle East, tensions rising with Iran, Ukraine’s future and America’s role, he said very little, offering neither a clear commitment nor a clear strategy. The Trump administration owes the American people an explanation about what our goals are in these conflicts. There needs to be a clearly defined strategy about what will define success and how we will get our brave men and women home. I promised you that I would do my best to offer context and clarity you don’t often find elsewhere, grounded insight that helps make sense of what’s actually happening in the world and why it matters. In this newsletter, I'm sharing with you my recent about Trump's speech and what's ahead with the upcoming midterm elections. I also have something special for you - We're told these conversations can't happen - where people with some very different views can get along and treat each other with respect! Guess what? They can! You'll find these items and much more below. I'd really appreciate any help you can provide in sharing this content within your network. Like all of you, I woke up this morning to the terrible news that Donald
Trump had taken us, yet again, to war with Iran. I recorded a statement,
which you can watch [ https://x.com/AbdulElSayed/status/2027741058142998734?s=20 ]here or read below.

[ A ]A screenshot of Abdul's post

Ask yourself who this war benefits. Does it benefit you or I? Does it make
our grocery prices any cheaper?

It doesn't address the fact that our health care is more expensive. It
doesn't make home ownership more attainable.

All it does is change the subject and distract us from the broken
presidency of Donald Trump.

This is a man who ran on "America first," who ran promising that the era
of regime change wars was over. Now, he's just taken us into another
foreign entanglement, the third one this year alone.

This is Trump admitting that he cannot solve the real problems. He will
not even try.

Instead, when those problems get bad enough, he's going to distract you.

He's going to distract you by weaponizing ICE on your streets, killing
American citizens, telling us that he's doing something about immigration,
while he's really just weaponizing and normalizing paramilitary force on
peaceful streets.

And now, he's going to take us to war — war with a nation of 93 million
people that's got serious ammunition and artillery behind it.

We don't know where this ends, but this is normalizing chaos because he
can't actually deal with the problems in your life.

This is an illegal war. There is no justification for it. He didn't even
try to justify it to Congress. He had every opportunity in the State of
the Union. He didn't. He's not trying to justify it to the international
community because, again, there is no justification.

How many American women and men are going to get broken over wars we never
should have fought? How much of our time and our treasure is going to be
spent shedding blood rather than saving lives here at home?

It’s unacceptable.

No war with Iran. We are going to stand up every single day to oppose
this.

In solidarity,

Abdul

Peter,

clean_body: If you’d like to unsubscribe, | | = Peter, Today marks the last day of Black History month, and the beginning of our final weekend to get out the vote before Tuesday’s primary, where North Carolinians will cast their ballots for the first time under new gerrymandered maps, designed to dilute Black voices and votes across our state and deliver more seats to Republicans. This isn’t just happening in North Carolina, Peter. All across the country, maps are being gerrymandered, polling sites are being removed, and voting rights are under attack. We’ve even seen that the Supreme Court is considering changes to section 2 of the Voting Rights Act which could lead to another wave of racial gerrymandering across the nation. So as we approach this final weekend ahead of our primary, we need to make one thing very clear: There is no reason why our region should lose one of its Black elected officials in this moment. But we’re running out of time to get our message out, since this weekend is really our final opportunity to knock doors, call voters and launch digital ads before Tuesday’s election. = | If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process now. | = | = | = | = | = | = Thanks for stepping up, Peter. name: Maj. Gen. Paul Eaton, U.S. Army, Retired
subject: Stop this war of choice
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTEVETS ACTION FUND
body:
Iranian missiles have targeted five U.S. bases in Bahrain, the UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, and Jordan. Israel is under attack. There are reports of explosions near an embassy and base in Iraq. More will come.
#
Three days ago I wrote to you warning what would happen if Republicans in Congress did nothing to prevent Trump from striking Iran. They did nothing. Now, Trump has acted unilaterally and attacked.
Iranian missiles have targeted five U.S. bases in Bahrain, the UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, and Jordan. Israel is under attack. There are reports of explosions near an embassy and base in Iraq. More will come.
This is a war of choice — Trump’s choice. There are 535 members of Congress, and not one voted for this.
I watched Iraq descend into chaos and bloodshed because the mission had no realistic political end state, no metrics for when it could end. That cannot be allowed to happen again.
Donald Trump wants the power of a king, but he does not have it — yet. Mike Johnson and John Thune must call Congress back to vote on Tim Kaine’s War Powers Resolution and block this war. If they do not, the blood of American Troops will be on their hands.
But the only way we get that done is by raising hell.
[**Peter, I implore you: Demand a vote to stop this war. We have asked a number of times and thousands have already signed on. Put yourself on record now.**](https://act.votevets.org/signup/260228_VV_EM_IRAN/?refcode=em260228-1-F&t=1&akid=34975%2E3013755%2ENjl9fH)

Paul Eaton

subject: No More Forever Wars

body:
Donald Trump does not have the authority to send more working class American kids to fight in Iran. It’s a regime change war, same as Iraq. It’s a war of choice. It’s wrong. It’s illegal. Period.
#

I woke up this morning at home in Arizona. I made breakfast for my son.
While I was doing it, I was thinking about where I was about two decades ago. My friends were getting blown up and killed in Al Anbar, Iraq. They died in an illegal war we never should’ve had to fight.
Donald Trump does not have the authority to send more working class American kids to fight in Iran. It’s a regime change war, same as Iraq. It’s a war of choice. It’s wrong. It’s illegal. Period.
Strikes are underway and Congress has not voted. John Thune needs to call the Senate back to vote on a War Powers Resolution to stop this. Tim Kaine has one in the Senate, and it needs to be voted on. I will take the next flight.
I need you with me on this.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126337364/604670655/1035002804?refcode=ea.82ac2c8a-be14-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&ms=ea.82ac2c8a-be14-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MmFjMmM4YS1iZTE0LWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=LJB8kByhh8Nsk15yy-ChwkETtaErAgTab_v7DCx7eiw=) Me with Justice Ginsburg in 1995. And as we face unprecedented threats to these values, I think often of how she would respond to them and how she would want me to. **[Justice Ginsburg taught us to fight for what we believe in — and do it in a way that others will join us. That’s my mission as I run to be your next governor. When I see the Supreme Court being asked, “if you're born here in the US, are you really a citizen?”, I know Justice Ginsburg would fight passionately against this attempt to claw back the 14th Amendment protections our nation established over a century ago.
**I will always fight back against lawless attempts to strip Americans of their citizenship.**
When _Roe v. Wade_ was overturned back in 2022 with the Supreme Court’s _Dobbs_ decision, I recalled my mentor and knew how appalled Justice Ginsburg would have been.
**I will always defend Coloradans’ right to abortion access and reproductive freedom.**
When the Supreme Court stands by its atrocious _Citizens United_ decision, which RBG called the Court’s worst recent decision, I know that we cannot just wait idly by.
**I will always fight for a political system that represents people, not corporations and the wealthy few — and that’s why I am championing a proposal to prevent corporations from donating to Colorado campaigns.**
And when we witness the Bully-in-Chief violating the rule of law in so many other ways — whether he’s coming after Colorado for our gold-standard election system, bypassing Congress to set tariffs that cause chaos for Colorado businesses and families, or sending ICE to spread terror in our communities — I know RBG would demand that we rise to the occasion. **I will never give in to this administration’s lawless bullying without putting up a fight.**
**[Justice Ginsburg taught me valuable lessons about using the law to stand up and deliver for all people. As your next governor, I will put those lessons into action. And to win in June, I need your support today. * **What Trump said:** The president called on members of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard, Iran's armed forces and police to lay down their weapons and accept immunity or "face certain death," reiterating "it has always been the policy of the United States, in particular my administration, that this terrorist regime can never have a nuclear weapon." The operation comes hours after Trump told reporters he was "not happy" with nuclear negotiations, having given Iran a roughly 10-15 day deadline on Feb. 19 to reach an agreement, saying "it's been mass terror and we are not going to put up with it any longer."

# **' Growing indications' Iran's Supreme Leader Khamenei killed in US-Israel strikes, Israeli sources say**
Israeli media outlet Channel 12 reported unnamed Israeli sources revealed there are **["growing indications" that Iran's Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei was killed](https://substack.com/redirect/b9b0a9e5-bedc-4601-9e59-deeeb765b97f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** during Saturday morning's US-Israel air strikes dubbed "Operation Epic Fury," or that he was "hurt at the very least." Khamenei has not been heard from since the attacks began, with both his palace and compound in Tehran reportedly completely destroyed and initial blasts believed to have occurred close to his offices.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b9b0a9e5-bedc-4601-9e59-deeeb765b97f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Why it matters:** The 86-year-old Khamenei has been Iran's supreme leader since 1989, holding ultimate control over all branches of Iran's government, the military, judiciary, and serving as the country's spiritual leader. President Trump specifically targeted Khamenei in the first wave of strikes, telling Iran's military to "lay down your weapons and have complete immunity, or in the alternative, face certain death."
* **Iran 's retaliation:** Iran launched what it called a "crushing response," firing missiles across Israel including Tel Aviv, Haifa and Jerusalem, and striking the US Fifth Fleet headquarters in Manama, Bahrain with dramatic footage showing a huge mushroom of smoke. Iran's military declared all US "bases, resources and assets" are "legitimate targets" and also targeted US infrastructure at Al Dhafra Air Base in the UAE, Ali Al Salem Air Base in Kuwait, Al Udeid Air Base in Qatar, and areas in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with explosions reported in Dubai and Syria.
* **The casualties:** Israeli sources said they believed IRGC commander General Mohammad Pakpour, described as the "architect" of Iran's brutal crackdown against protesters, has been killed in the strikes. Officials reported the strikes caused "very significant harm" to the leadership of the Iranian regime and its military commanders. Countries across the world are appealing for calm and urgent de-escalation, with UK Prime Minister Sir Keir Starmer holding an emergency Cobra meeting in Downing Street, while Iran and Israel continue to exchange fire with multiple waves of strikes across the Middle East.

French President Emmanuel Macron called President Trump's attack on Iran **["dangerous for all" in a statement posted on social media](https://substack.com/redirect/7ff172e7-4ed8-4972-a2a0-ca0bd4cb4f3c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**, urging "it must stop" and calling for an urgent meeting of the United Nations Security Council as other European leaders indicated their unease with Trump's decision to launch Operation Epic Fury on Tehran.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7ff172e7-4ed8-4972-a2a0-ca0bd4cb4f3c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

* **The backdrop:** The comments come after Trump and Israel launched Operation Epic Fury on Saturday, Feb. 28, 2026, targeting Iran's supreme leader, president, and multiple high-ranking Islamic commanders and regime officials. Reports indicate Iran has already launched retaliatory strikes near a US Navy base in Bahrain with a barrage of missiles, while Saudi Arabia has pledged to aid Trump's attack.

Bringing this theory back shows both how desperate opponents of voting rights are and how scared they are of the upcoming election.
While they focus on protecting their own power through fringe legal challenges, we're focused on informing voters, getting them registered, and getting as many voters to turn out as possible.
Fuel our efforts to protect our fundamental right to vote with $35 or more right now >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=022826_1&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
BCJ: Independent State Legislature Theory [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=022826_1&amount=25]
In 2023 the U.S. Supreme Court decided Moore v. Harper, which rejected the so-called "independent state legislature" (ISL) theory. In theory.
Now opponents of voting rights are revisiting this fringe legal theory to give state legislatures nearly unchecked authority to gerrymander electoral maps and pass voter suppression laws. Facing mounting setbacks to their nationwide gerrymanders, the vote suppressors are citing this fringe legal theory to block voter referendums, court-ordered maps, and other safeguards built into our democracy that may threaten their partisan electoral advantage.
This is all about the upcoming midterm elections. Voters and courts are pushing back against some egregious partisan and racial gerrymanders by striking down or threatening to block the use of those maps. In response, opponents of voting rights want to use this "independent state legislature" constitutional argument to sideline those very checks on their power.
In state after state, the battle is no longer just about how district lines are drawn, but about who gets a say in the process. Which is why we've got to inform voters about this theory and how to defend our fundamental right to vote before it's too late . The fate of mail-in ballots, early voting programs, 3rd party voter outreach, and so much more is at risk around the country.
Fuel our efforts to reach every voter possible ahead of November with $35 or whatever you can today and help increase voter participation nationwide >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=022826_1&amount=35]

Don't remember the ISL theory? You're not alone.
The ISL is a right-wing constitutional theory about who has the power to set rules for federal elections. The theory interprets the word “legislature” in the U.S. Constitution to mean that state legislatures — and only state legislatures — can make laws regulating federal elections. This differs from the standard interpretation, in which “legislature” means the state’s general lawmaking process, which includes the governor’s veto, citizen-led ballot measures and rulings of state courts.
We need to make sure that the role of the judiciary -- and voters -- in determining and protecting voting rights laws is upheld. The ISL could weaken long-standing, constitutionally grounded checks on partisan abuses and deal a severe blow to representative democracy. We can't let that happen on our watch.
The vote suppressors will keep testing the limits of their power and these obscure, fringe theories as long as they can in order to protect their own power. Stopping them will take a lot of work and a strong response at the ballot box in a few months.
Chip in to push back on the vote suppressors and their fringe theories with $35 or whatever you can. Together we can inform voters and turn them out to protect our democracy! >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=022826_1&amount=35]
