name: Ernest Lineberger
subject: Invitations - Update from Ernest Lineberger, February 28, 2026 ​
body:
[image: image.png]

Hi Friends of Lineberger for US Congress!

I want to open this email with the two most important parts. To make a
difference, we have to win this election. So, here are some critical
invitations for those of you eligible to vote in my district.

*Invitation #1:* *Vote in the Primary:* If you haven’t already voted in the
primary election, please accept my invitation to do so. Every vote counts.
Winning this BIG will make a statement that will help us with more name
recognition and message reach through the general election.

*Voting is a multistep process: Go to website: VoteDenton.gov (or
votetexas.gov <http://votetexas.gov> if not in Denton County) Select:
Current and Upcoming Elections Select: Sample Ballot Lookup Enter your
first name, last name, birthdate and select ‘search’*

*This will reveal your registration status, show your one and only allowed
polling location, and allow you to preview and print your sample ballot.*

*Once you are prepared, go to your assigned polling location on Tuesday,
March 3rd between 7 AM and 7 PM to get in line with your ID and vote (vote
for me).*

*Invitation #2: Election Watch Party: * Come Join Us to share the
excitement as we watch the Primary Election Results for this historic 2026
Democratic primary with candidates for every seat in the US House, plus
every seat in the Texas House, and every seat up for election in the Texas
Senate. We have Statewide elections, many with primary opponents, for US
Senate, Texas Governor, Lt. Governor, Attorney General and more. This will
be an important moment as together we determine the Democratic slate for
the November General Election (and also see who will be the Republican
opponents).

We have a patio room (closed in and climate controlled) overlooking the
lake at Angelina’s Don Fanciso’s restaurant in The Colony, not far from HWY
121 and Josey/Main (423). Delicious Tex-Mex food and beverages available
for purchase (and please do to support our use of the space).
The polling place lines close at 7 PM. Our event will start at 6:30 PM.
Bring a friend and be part of the energy.

Please sign up on Mobilize to let us update the restaurant on how much
space to reserve. *https://www.mobilize.us/dentondemocrats/event/905263/*
<https://www.mobilize.us/dentondemocrats/event/905263/?fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAYnJpZBExUWw4NWJIcmV0SGdiQjBoV3NydGMGYXBwX2lkEDIyMjAzOTE3ODgyMDA4OTIAAR51ZsGRCE0_1qsBzaLjddEyAd2XGd8biB6hlbB1ZGWuR1Fo4FYXGXCeYzalOA_aem_SM3uSUaGK1DUQ4vyzNszMg>

*We’ve been working:*

Since my last Update email to you, I (and a lot of dedicated volunteers)
have been getting out and telling many in the district that *I want to work
for them* *(You!).* That is the big difference between me and our
Republican congressman. He works for Trump and the wealthy-donors. *I
want to work for you*.

We have been attending and hosting events, poll greeting – catching voters
just before they enter the polls for one last reminder, and doing lots of
block walking for multiple candidates. We have been growing our digital
advertising campaign. This may be the single-most expensive item in our
campaign arsenal, but it is effective and far-reaching, giving multiple
touches to hundreds of thousands of district voters. We are also sending
reminders to vote by texting.

Now, early voting for the primary election is over. Democratic voter
turnout has been more than twice anything we have seen in the past. People
are eager for change, anxious to put the brakes on the Trump 2.0 Executive
overreach of tariffs and war powers. We want government to make our lives
better.

This is great for Democrats, motivating and expanding our base. However,
it doesn’t guarantee a win for us in this election or in November. It’s a
great sign, but we have to remain vigilant and active to improve our
future. Hence, invitation #1 above. *Please go vote for me* to help me
pass this important hurdle.

*News Continues:*

The latest this morning was attacks on Iran and counter attacks from Iran.
This is unfortunate. I am a strong believer that President Trump has
messed this up from the beginning. When he backed out of the Iran nuclear
deal, we lost a lot of opportunity to bring Iran into alignment with the
rest of the modern world. We could have shown Iran that it is better to
join with society in peace than to build on terror. With the loss of that
relationship, and the chaos of the Trump 2.0 administration, we have
deteriorated to this and are much less safe for it. Congressional
Democrats are doing what they can to hold the administration accountable
and stop these extreme behaviors, but we need to win back the majority in
the House to make real gains. Hence my campaign. And your support is
appreciated so much.

I’ll come out with more details on future plans for the campaign after the
primary election results are clear. For now, we are focused on the primary
election.

*Invitation #3: Help Meals on Wheels:* Many of you know that I am active
in our community, actively donating and participating with various
community support organizations. As a board member of Span/Meals on Wheels
of Denton County, I want to invite you to our biggest and critical annual
fundraiser called Breakin’, being held March 28th 6-10 PM at the Courtyard
by Marriott Flower Mound (4330 Courtyard Way). More details are available
on the website reachable by this link in two formats.
Span and Meals on Wheels <https://span-transit.org/>
https://span-transit.org/
Or you can go directly to ticket / table purchase for the event at this link
Donation Form
<https://wl.donorperfect.net/weblink/WebLink.aspx?name=E12808&id=14>

Thank you so much for your continued support! We are building to make the
2026 election fall in the favor of the people.

One Community – Diverse But Not Divided.

Putting People’s Needs First!

Elect me so that I can work for you!

Ernest Lineberger

Democratic Candidate for US House of Representatives (Texas CD26)

LinebergerforUScongress.com <http://linebergerforuscongress.com/>

body:
I realize it can feel daunting sometimes.
# [](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1&akid=5355%2E582294%2EplFhnB)
If you don’t know what’s at stake in Chris Pappas’s campaign to keep New Hampshire’s Senate seat blue, look no further than who’s funding this race:
🔴 On the Republican side, you’ve got corporate special interests, MAGA billionaires, **Betsy DeVos, George W. Bush, Wall Street, and Big Oil** _pouring_ money into John Sununu’s campaign.
🔵 And who’s supporting Chris Pappas? This grassroots campaign is proudly funded by **teachers, nurses, and small business owners** – all chipping in what they can, when they can.
I realize it can feel daunting to compete with the rich and powerful special interests.
But I am filled with hope: Because there are _so many more of us than there are of them._
**If just 25% of people reading this message chip in, we’ll be on track to _surpass_ this month’s fundraising goal and keep Chris in the fight to defend Democrats’ only viable path to flip the Senate.**
**[Can Chris count on you to be one of the few we need to step up? Please donate $5 or more before midnight tonight to help Chris win this critical seat in the U.S. Senate.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260228_1.bGnhS1&refcode=em20260228-1&t=2&akid=5355%2E582294%2EplFhnB)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260228_1.bGnhS1&amount=5&refcode=em20260228-1&t=21&akid=5355%2E582294%2EplFhnB)**
Thank you for taking action to prove that New Hampshire isn’t for sale. I know how much your support means to Chris.
Thank you,
Rachel Petri
Campaign Manager, Team Pappas
P.S. With the GOP all-in to buy this race, we have no choice but to prove once and for all that New Hampshire can’t be bought out by the MAGA billionaires. **[Please chip in $5 before midnight to share our message across New Hampshire, hire on-the-ground staff, and build events so we can win this critical race.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260228_1.bGnhS1&refcode=em20260228-1&t=22&akid=5355%2E582294%2EplFhnB)**
**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_cp_footer?refcode=em20260228-1&t=23&refcode2=5355_582294_plFhnB&akid=5355%2E582294%2EplFhnB)**

It does not take much to make Congressional Democrats throw a hissy fit these days, especially whenever President Donald Trump makes his way to Capitol Hill.
Tuesday is when Trump gave his annual State of the Union address. While some argue such speeches have long lost their impactfulness, it does give presidents the opportunity to set the tone for the year and highlight their successes. After all, when former President Joe Biden gave his SOTU in 2024 and did not completely fail it, quite the low bar, many Democrats used it to justify having the ailing man be their nominee of that election (Talk about a backfire).
Before Trump even took the podium, over 70 Democrats made a big deal about not attending the speech.
"I will be hearing from the people of my district about their personal experiences with skyrocketing costs, new barriers to health care, dismantled Social Security services, and brutal cuts to medical research," House Minority Whip Katherine Clark (D-Mass.) **[said in a statement.](https://substack.com/redirect/dd78eb6e-b9b1-49cb-a9b9-94437be5db4d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** She is the number two Democrat in the House.
Many of the Democrats who will not attend the speech instead participated in a rally dubbed "the "People's State of the Union, which took place on the National Mall and organized by left-wing groups MoveOn and MeidasTouch.
_**A message from our sponsor (piece continues below)**_

# **[Trump's 2026 Economic Revolution Is Coming...](https://substack.com/redirect/39c3c584-f360-4215-9b01-42478b2caa8c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
### _But Your IRA or 401(k) May Not Be Ready For It_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/39c3c584-f360-4215-9b01-42478b2caa8c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
President Trump's "One Big Beautiful Bill" strives to deliver the largest tax cuts for working and middle-class Americans in our country's history. His bold plan is designed to finally empower the American worker and break the grip of the elites.
But we have to be honest with you about the friction this creates. **Here is the "[Silent Risk](https://substack.com/redirect/39c3c584-f360-4215-9b01-42478b2caa8c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" nobody is talking about:**
The established financial system -- the one your 401(k) and IRA are likely trapped in -- was built for the "Old Guard." It relies on stability, slow growth, and political compliance.
When Trump initiates this massive economic pivot, it could send a shockwave through that old, fragile infrastructure. Wall Street banks assume they can use your retirement savings as their liquidity pool. They assume you will remain passive while the rules of the game change.
**[But you have a choice, if you know where to look.](https://substack.com/redirect/39c3c584-f360-4215-9b01-42478b2caa8c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
We've outlined a specific, controversial protocol inside the 2026 Patriot's Wealth Defense Guide.
This isn't just a savings strategy; it's considered an asymmetric advantage. And if you are an American Citizen with more than $50,000 in retirement, you may already be eligible to receive the benefits detailed in this free guide.
**[Confirm Your Eligibility: Get the 2026 Patriot's Wealth Defense Guide today](https://substack.com/redirect/39c3c584-f360-4215-9b01-42478b2caa8c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Learn More](https://substack.com/redirect/39c3c584-f360-4215-9b01-42478b2caa8c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
_**(Piece continues)**_
"He's made a mockery of the State of the Union speech and he doesn't deserve an audience," **[Senator Christopher Murphy (D-Conn.) said.](https://substack.com/redirect/36aec627-33e8-49c3-9fe8-1786bf23b600?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** "He's going to tell 40 different lies, call Democrats names; he's going to paper over his corruption; and I don't feel like what he's doing dignifies having Democrats there to cloak the speech in a veneer of respectability."
Senator Chris Van Hollen (D-Md.), who went to great lengths to bring back illegal alien Kilmar Abrego Garcia after his deportation, said, "We cannot normalize this moment when Trump is marching our country toward fascism. I refuse to be a prop in the chamber as Donald Trump shreds our Constitution and attacks our democracy."
Reading between the lines, it seems Democrats realize their outbursts, interruptions, and odd use of paddles made them look foolish and ineffective. Democrats are under extreme pressure from their base to take drastic measures to resist Trump and his administration. It is part of the reason why they have been on board with the unhinged and dangerous behavior from anti-ICE rioters.
While it is highly doubtful there was any impact from the boycotting, it did not stop Democrats from making a lot of noise.

subject: We’ve taken on President Trump before. Let’s do it again.
body:

There’s no sugarcoating this: President Trump is openly floating the idea that he might not recognize the midterm results.
He’s already claimed Democrats can “only win by cheating.” He’s already sued states for voter data. He’s already sent federal agents into election offices.
And now, he’s arguing the federal government should “nationalize” elections.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260228em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260228em]
FIGHT BACK [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260228em]
Let me be direct: That is not how our democracy works. The Constitution is clear that states run elections — not presidents, not the FBI, not the Justice Department.
As Oregon’s Secretary of State, it is my job to protect our elections from interference — whether it comes from conspiracy theorists online or in the Oval Office.
We’ve already beaten Trump-backed efforts in court. When his allies tried to force access to sensitive voter information, we stopped them. And if they try to cross another line, we will fight them — and win — again.
But here’s the reality: Donald Trump and his allies are extremely well-funded, and they’re already getting prepared to cause chaos in the upcoming midterm elections.
That’s why this end-of-month deadline matters — because defending Oregon’s democracy requires that we be just as prepared as Donald Trump. But I cannot do this alone.
If you believe Oregon’s elections should be decided by Oregon voters — not by a president testing the limits of his power — I’m asking you to step up before our end-of-month deadline. Please contribute today to help us communicate about defending Oregon’s elections and keeping them secure, independent, and free from federal interference. | | | Donald Trump has gotten us into an actual war with Iran, one that could rapidly escalate into something truly horrific. [**Congress has the power to stop this. Tell them to use it. **](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4b9e6b4d-c2de-4637-a180-1ab570d13ab2/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Trump seems hellbent on a major war with Iran, launching this new attack just as it was reported we were finalizing a deal with Iran on a range of contentious issues, including their nuclear program. He had the deal, and then chose to blow it up. Iran has nearly 100 million people, with just under a million in its active-duty military and reserves. And it may already have nuclear weapons. It also has the ability to close off the Strait of Hormuz, stopping a enormous amount of the world's oil exports, and driving oil prices to unprecedented levels. This is not a cake walk, it is an extremely dangerous undertaking, and Trump appears to have no idea what he's gotten us into. [**Tell Congress: "You have the power to end Trump's war with Iran. # [When the Bombs Fall and Congress Does Fundraisers](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2883939&post_id=189499105&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTg5NDk5MTA1LCJpYXQiOjE3NzIzMTU5MTMsImV4cCI6MTc3NDkwNzkxMywiaXNzIjoicHViLTI4ODM5MzkiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.DRORES5KUZxHule42U9aCNlubB3VIP2s88h3Hyf6HJk)
### What my dad, NATO and a Trump tweet from 2012 tell us about this moment
| | [Caroline Gleich](https://substack.com/@carolinegleich)
---
| Feb 28
---
| [](https://substack.com/@carolinegleich)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2883939&post_id=189499105&utm_source=substack&isFreemail=true&submitLike=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTg5NDk5MTA1LCJyZWFjdGlvbiI6IuKdpCIsImlhdCI6MTc3MjMxNTkxMywiZXhwIjoxNzc0OTA3OTEzLCJpc3MiOiJwdWItMjg4MzkzOSIsInN1YiI6InJlYWN0aW9uIn0.rmz8R1kCQYTV0DqA2M8ymw5-lf_gqNUYUYM7jGLBSmg&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=email-reaction&r=1hvr60)
---
| | [](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2883939&post_id=189499105&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&isFreemail=true&comments=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTg5NDk5MTA1LCJpYXQiOjE3NzIzMTU5MTMsImV4cCI6MTc3NDkwNzkxMywiaXNzIjoicHViLTI4ODM5MzkiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.DRORES5KUZxHule42U9aCNlubB3VIP2s88h3Hyf6HJk&r=1hvr60&utm_campaign=email-half-magic-comments&action=post-comment&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2883939&post_id=189499105&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTg5NDk5MTA1LCJpYXQiOjE3NzIzMTU5MTMsImV4cCI6MTc3NDkwNzkxMywiaXNzIjoicHViLTI4ODM5MzkiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.DRORES5KUZxHule42U9aCNlubB3VIP2s88h3Hyf6HJk)
---
| | [](https://substack.._yf5mj7dbyOsfTmoRsAdsNwg84FxJCs-ceFv6T3kGOA?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/carolinegleich/p/when-the-bombs-fall-and-congress?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

I was just starting my junior year of high school on September 11, 2001. I watched America go to war on emotion, without a clear strategy, and spend the next twenty years paying for it in lives and moral authority we still haven't fully recovered. Some of my friends who served still suffer from PTSD.
This morning, the United States joined Israel in striking Iran in what Trump himself called a "massive and ongoing" military campaign. There was no Congressional vote or declaration of war. Most lawmakers learned about it after American planes had already left Iranian airspace.
Caroline Gleich ⛰️ is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..w00OJW9xNS_UX-VkcoZoLHc5cQuG4SldxTCkDyDCeyI?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=189499105)
Congress was on recess. Most members were fundraising.

As an athlete, activist and former US Senate candidate, I've spent years engaging with NATO's framework for collective security largely from the inspiration of my 94-year-old dad, who served in the Air Force (and also protested the Vietnam War) He told me, "NATO is a force for good in the world. NATO will help us prevent the mistakes of history." As a mountaineer, I've walked the alleys of Skardu, Pakistan where "down with the USA" was graffitied on the walls. I've met with NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte. I ran for the US Senate in Utah because I believe these institutions matter, including the Constitution, the alliances, and the democratic checks and balances that separate us from the autocracies we claim to oppose. What's happening right now tests all of it.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e1609592-2c23-48a5-bfd8-7cffce4bddf6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b7ef2a46-523b-40d9-bc20-aab24322a7c7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

Iran's regime is genuinely dangerous. The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) is genuinely dangerous, having armed terrorist proxies, killed Americans and destabilized the region for decades. But we struck Iran while they were actively negotiating nuclear concessions. History will ask us why. We've also learned from the mistakes of history that external actors "freeing" countries from their governments rarely goes well.

As of today, reports confirm Iran's Supreme Leader Khamenei was killed in the strikes, along with top IRGC leadership. What comes next, succession crisis, regime collapse or something more dangerous is anyone's guess. That uncertainty alone demands Congressional oversight.

Bombing a country during active diplomacy, without congressional authorization, sets a precedent about who holds war powers in this democracy. The current answer appears to be one man, alone, without a vote. That should concern us all. In 2012, Donald Trump warned Republicans in a tweet
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/251fcbf9-feb9-4eaa-b64c-768e6fa49fd2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Trump's own approval rating has dropped 14 points since taking office. Midterms are eight months away. He has now done exactly what he accused Obama of planning. His own words are the indictment.

Representatives Thomas Massie and Ro Khanna, a libertarian Republican and a progressive Democrat, already had a War Powers Resolution ready. Senators Tim Kaine and Rand Paul introduced a companion resolution in the Senate. Both chambers vote next week on it. Every member of Congress will go on record, including Utah's.

I'd also note that[ Senator Curtis's own 2024 financial disclosure, filed August 2025, ](https://substack.com/redirect/b70e6015-6718-46f1-a9a9-6192c5ad6b3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)public record, shows he currently holds a Director position at ATI Founders Inc., which sells shooting range equipment under the Action Target brand to the Department of Defense, with between $500,000 and $1,000,000 in personal holdings. When he calls this campaign an act of strength, Utahns deserve that context.
I don't have all the answers about Iran. Nobody does. But I know this: the people who will fight this war, fund it, and live with its consequences for decades deserve a Congress that shows up to vote on it.
The Constitution requires it. Our future demands it.
_Contact your representative. Demand a vote on H. Con. Res. 38._

There was no Congressional vote or declaration of war. Most lawmakers learned about it after American planes had already left Iranian airspace. Caroline Gleich ⛰️ is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber. Congress was on recess. Most members were fundraising. As an athlete, activist and former US Senate candidate, I've spent years engaging with NATO's framework for collective security largely from the inspiration of my 94-year-old dad, who served in the Air Force (and also protested the Vietnam War) He told me, "NATO is a force for good in the world. NATO will help us prevent the mistakes of history." As a mountaineer, I've walked the alleys of Skardu, Pakistan where "down with the USA" was graffitied on the walls. I've met with NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte. I ran for the US Senate in Utah because I believe these institutions matter, including the Constitution, the alliances, and the democratic checks and balances that separate us from the autocracies we claim to oppose. What's happening right now tests all of it. | | ---|---|--- | | ---|---|--- Iran's regime is genuinely dangerous. The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) is genuinely dangerous, having armed terrorist proxies, killed Americans and destabilized the region for decades. But we struck Iran while they were actively negotiating nuclear concessions. History will ask us why. We've also learned from the mistakes of history that external actors "freeing" countries from their governments rarely goes well. As of today, reports confirm Iran's Supreme Leader Khamenei was killed in the strikes, along with top IRGC leadership. What comes next, succession crisis, regime collapse or something more dangerous is anyone's guess. That uncertainty alone demands Congressional oversight. Bombing a country during active diplomacy, without congressional authorization, sets a precedent about who holds war powers in this democracy. The current answer appears to be one man, alone, without a vote. That should concern us all. In 2012, Donald Trump warned Republicans in a tweet | | ---|---|--- Trump's own approval rating has dropped 14 points since taking office. Midterms are eight months away. He has now done exactly what he accused Obama of planning. His own words are the indictment. Representatives Thomas Massie and Ro Khanna, a libertarian Republican and a progressive Democrat, already had a War Powers Resolution ready. Senators Tim Kaine and Rand Paul introduced a companion resolution in the Senate. Both chambers vote next week on it. Every member of Congress will go on record, including Utah's. I'd also note that record, shows he currently holds a Director position at ATI Founders Inc., which sells shooting range equipment under the Action Target brand to the Department of Defense, with between $500,000 and $1,000,000 in personal holdings. When he calls this campaign an act of strength, Utahns deserve that context. I don't have all the answers about Iran. Nobody does. But I know this: the people who will fight this war, fund it, and live with its consequences for decades deserve a Congress that shows up to vote on it. The Constitution requires it. Our future demands it. Contact your representative. Demand a vote on H. Con. Res. 38. Caroline Gleich ⛰️ is a reader-supported publication. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

I watched Iraq descend into chaos and bloodshed because the mission had no realistic political end state, no metrics for when it could end. That cannot be allowed to happen again. Donald Trump wants the power of a king, but he does not have it — yet. Mike Johnson and John Thune must call Congress back to vote on Tim Kaine’s War Powers Resolution and block this war. If they do not, the blood of American Troops will be on their hands. But the only way we get that done is by raising hell. | Thank you. Days like today remind us how much elections matter. With the March primary elections in Texas right around the corner, #TeamLizzie is doing everything we can to get out the vote—and I am glad to share a few snapshots from the trail.
Block Walking in Fort Bend County
Last Saturday morning, I was in Mission Bend block walking with Dexter McCoy, who’s running for Fort Bend County Judge. There is nothing more powerful than neighbors talking to neighbors about what’s at stake in this election.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe260228?refcode=lpfe260228 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe260228?refcode=lpfe260228]
It’s time to reach out to your friends and family and make a plan to vote in the primary.
Fort Bend County voters can find everything they need here:
http://fortbendcountytx.gov/elections [http://fortbendcountytx.gov/elections]
Knocking Doors with Abbie Kamin
I also loved spending time with so many friends at our #TX07 HQ before heading out to West U to block walk with Abbie Kamin, who’s running for Harris County Attorney.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe260228?refcode=lpfe260228 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe260228?refcode=lpfe260228]
It was a great day of knocking doors, talking about our vision for the community, and making sure folks have a plan to vote during #GOTV. I voted for Abbie, and I hope you will, too.
Harris County voters can find voting information here:
https://harrisvotes.com [https://harrisvotes.com]
Organizing in The Heights
On Sunday, I started the day at a friendly neighborhood gathering in The Heights, meeting new #TX07 voters and talking about what’s ahead. Democrats are organizing across our county—and across our country—one neighbor at a time. That’s how we win.
Later, I joined the Greater Heights Democratic Club at Stanton’s City Bites before their block walk in new areas of #TX07. Great conversation, delicious food, and a very good cause: Democracy 2026.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe260228?refcode=lpfe260228 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe260228?refcode=lpfe260228]
Tonight is also the February end-of-month deadline—and the last monthly benchmark before the primary election on Tuesday. If you’re able, please consider making a contribution to help us win in TX-07 and to help Democrats up and down the ballot win this year in Texas and across the country. | | | | | |
**PRESS RELEASE**

**Justin Story Praises U.S. Troops for Heroic Action Against Iran, Hails Path to New Government and Freedom** _**“Our troops have once again proven they are the finest fighting force on Earth. Their courage and precision delivered a decisive blow to a dangerous regime, ending the rule of Supreme Leader Khamenei and creating a generational opportunity for the Iranian people to form a new government and embrace freedom.” - Justin Story**_
---
|
---
| | February 28, 2026Contact: [Justin@VoteJustinStory.com](mailto:justin@votejustinstory.com?subject=&body=)
---
| |

**ST. CLOUD, FL** — Justin Story, Republican candidate for Congress in Florida’s 9th Congressional District and retired U.S. Marine Corps officer, today saluted the extraordinary bravery and skill of American service members who executed the joint U.S.-Israel operation against Iran on February 28, 2026.“Our sailors, airmen, soldiers, and Marines carried out this critical mission with unmatched professionalism and resolve,” Story said. “I am profoundly proud of every one of them. Their service has protected our homeland, our allies, and future generations from the grave threats posed by Iran’s nuclear ambitions and terrorist proxies.”
The strikes significantly degraded Iran’s nuclear facilities, missile capabilities, and military leadership. Reports indicate Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei is dead, with his compound destroyed and body found, marking the end of his decades-long rule and opening the door for a new government in Iran.
Story echoed President Trump’s assessment of the historic moment: “As President Trump stated, this is a ‘generational opportunity’ for the Iranian people, ‘your only chance for generations’ to take over their government, seize control of their destiny, and unleash a prosperous and glorious future. Our troops have heroically opened that door. With the regime’s top figures eliminated and its ability to export terror diminished, Iran now has a real path to a new government, freedom from oppression, and lasting stability in the Middle East,allowing nations to pursue prosperity instead of conflict.”
Story concluded: “Florida’s military families know the true cost of service. They deserve our unwavering support and policies that honor their sacrifices by keeping America strong and the world safer.”
Justin Story is a retired U.S. Marine Corps officer, husband, father, and sixth-generation Central Floridian running for Congress in Florida’s 9th Congressional District.For learn more about Justin and his campaign, visit [VoteJustinStory.com](https://votejustinstory.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=aa75fb334e8c06de90a8e46d5&id=625d89f143&e=90ad5fc3c5) or contact [justin@votejustinstory.com](mailto:justin@votejustinstory.com?subject=&body=). ###

name: Rose For Congress
subject: The bombs have started falling
body:
I support Congress reconvening immediately and asserting its constitutional authority over war powers.

| | | | | [|

| | | | | |
## The bombs have started falling
---
| |
Friend,
Yesterday, we warned that the drumbeat toward war with Iran was growing louder. Today, that fear has become reality.
The bombs have started falling. A joint Israeli and U.S. air strike on a school has killed and wounded young children. Families are devastated. Communities are traumatized. This unlawful war that the U.S. is waging upon urging, and in partnership with Israel, has got to be stopped.
[**Now, as much as ever, we need to elect representatives who will once and for all reject illegal wars of aggression and embrace a platform that focuses on people, peace, and the planet. Will you donate to my campaign to ensure CA-02 has a committed anti-war option on the ballot?**](https://roseforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35bf91c695e8f4a5dc8a9dd42&id=e7e02ddb13&e=8c53948e4c)
---
| [DONATE](https://roseforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35bf91c695e8f4a5dc8a9dd42&id=24efe33961&e=8c53948e4c)
---
| | **I support Congress reconvening immediately and asserting its constitutional authority over war powers. There must be transparency, debate, and accountability, and no further escalation. Democrats must reject this war. I urge all representatives to vote YES on Ro Khanna and Thomas Massie's War Powers Resolution.**
We reject the idea that war was inevitable. We reject the notion that endless war is the price of security. And we reject the bipartisan establishment consensus that prioritizes imperialist expansion over human wellbeing.
That is why I am running for Congress. America should prioritize our people - providing healthcare, housing, education, and climate resilience. We should not engage in wars abroad while our communities struggle at home.
[**If you agree, will you send a small donation to keep our campaign momentum going strong?**](https://roseforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35bf91c695e8f4a5dc8a9dd42&id=c50b1dfddd&e=8c53948e4c)
It’s time to elect Democrats who will stand up to Donald Trump and the military industrial complex.

---
| |

In solidarity,Rose Penelope YeeCandidate, US Congress CA-02

name: David Hogg
subject: This is a difficult moment
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
Every day, we’re waking up to fresh chaos and louder headlines.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260228-2&t=1&akid=3198%2E587540%2ErL6EzM)
I know how this moment feels, Peter.
Every day, we’re waking up to fresh chaos and louder headlines. The stakes are high, and even the people who care the most are exhausted. If you’re feeling that burnout right now, you’re not alone — and you’re not wrong for feeling that way.
I experienced an extreme form of it after the midterm elections in 2018, following the shooting in Parkland. After the shooting, thousands of people (older adults in particular) said the same thing to the student activists from Parkland over and over: “You know my generation really screwed things up. Thank God you kids are here to save us.” Many of us, including myself, took that to heart. I remember completely losing track of what day it was, working so hard to turnout and rally young people to vote to defeat the NRA. In those days, the only way I would let myself stop was if I was so ill I physically could not get out of bed. Then, in November, Democrats won back the House — _but basically nothing changed._ It was devastating. So the next year I traveled the country speaking with activists and community leaders who have been combating gun violence for decades.
From those conversations, and a lot of therapy, I learned the one thing that has enabled me to keep going 8 years later.
I realized how many people had been working to prevent gun violence for decades long before I was even born. From that I realized I can take breaks because when I am not working there are other people out there doing the work and when they need a break they can rest knowing myself and others are stepping up when they can’t. That’s why when the time came for me to go to college and step back from day to day activism, I knew I could. I knew I could step back when I saw people like my friend and gun violence prevention advocate, Maxwell Frost, step up, run for Congress, get elected, and play a major role in the creation of the Office of Gun Violence Prevention at the White House.
And guess what...
In the two years of that office’s existence — prior to Trump totally dismantling it — we saw the two largest one-year drops in gun homicides in our nation's history. That's the power of bringing young people into government who understand the experience of a school shooter drill.
**That’s why Leaders We Deserve exists. We aren’t here to elect younger versions of those in power now, but to instead bring into power truly generational leaders who get results, like Maxwell Frost.**
So if you are exhausted now, it’s better to rest before you burn out. And you can rest knowing that there is a generation of new leaders we are supporting coming into power who can pick up the torch and get it to the finish line.
_But only with your support._

clean_body: Every day, we’re waking up to fresh chaos and louder headlines. I know how this moment feels, Peter. Every day, we’re waking up to fresh chaos and louder headlines. The stakes are high, and even the people who care the most are exhausted. If you’re feeling that burnout right now, you’re not alone — and you’re not wrong for feeling that way. I experienced an extreme form of it after the midterm elections in 2018, following the shooting in Parkland. After the shooting, thousands of people (older adults in particular) said the same thing to the student activists from Parkland over and over: “You know my generation really screwed things up. Thank God you kids are here to save us.” Many of us, including myself, took that to heart. I remember completely losing track of what day it was, working so hard to turnout and rally young people to vote to defeat the NRA. In those days, the only way I would let myself stop was if I was so ill I physically could not get out of bed. Then, in November, Democrats won back the House — but basically nothing changed. It was devastating. So the next year I traveled the country speaking with activists and community leaders who have been combating gun violence for decades. From those conversations, and a lot of therapy, I learned the one thing that has enabled me to keep going 8 years later. I realized how many people had been working to prevent gun violence for decades long before I was even born. From that I realized I can take breaks because when I am not working there are other people out there doing the work and when they need a break they can rest knowing myself and others are stepping up when they can’t. That’s why when the time came for me to go to college and step back from day to day activism, I knew I could. I knew I could step back when I saw people like my friend and gun violence prevention advocate, Maxwell Frost, step up, run for Congress, get elected, and play a major role in the creation of the Office of Gun Violence Prevention at the White House. And guess what... In the two years of that office’s existence — prior to Trump totally dismantling it — we saw the two largest one-year drops in gun homicides in our nation's history. That's the power of bringing young people into government who understand the experience of a school shooter drill. That’s why Leaders We Deserve exists. We aren’t here to elect younger versions of those in power now, but to instead bring into power truly generational leaders who get results, like Maxwell Frost. So if you are exhausted now, it’s better to rest before you burn out. And you can rest knowing that there is a generation of new leaders we are supporting coming into power who can pick up the torch and get it to the finish line. But only with your support. Thank you for staying in this fight even when it's hard. — David

clean_body: Can you help keep us on track? | | | When power-hungry MAGA extremists try to end free and fair elections so they can impose their radical agenda on the rest of America, we don’t give up — we fight back. We = for democracy. We = for every voter’s right to be heard. We = for a government that answers to the will of the people and doesn’t trample over all our freedoms. And right now, we’ve got our work cut out for us, = Here’s why it’s so critical to help keep our numbers on track: This year, we’ll need to elect Democracy Champions up and down the ballot — in critical races nearly every month this year that will help decide how elections are run and whether voters face unjust obstacles on the way to the ballot box. We’re also actively recruiting, training, and supporting Democracy Watch volunteers to monitor County Board of Registration and Elections and Board of Commissioners meetings — so we can track changes that affect voting access and procedures, call out any “funny business,” and stand up for the freedom to vote in the rooms where key decisions are made. Throughout 2026, we’ll need to expose, mitigate, and thwart the far right’s voter suppression efforts as they try to dodge accountability in the midterm elections. And if the Supreme Court, as expected, clears the way for Republican state lawmakers to draw new racially discriminatory voting maps that give them a generation-long grip on power, we’ll need to push back head-on. = If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically: | = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- In solidarity, The Fair Fight Team * = = | 1270 Caroline Street | Suite D120-430 | Atlanta, GA 30307 ©2026 Fair Fight - All rights reserved. # [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=9586%2E5257348%2Ej31S4Y)
Derek, Last night, Donald Trump ordered yet another strike against Iran, this one larger and more deadly than the last. **Trump is drawing our country and its service members into yet another foreign war that Americans don’t want and that Congress has not authorized.** Americans do not want more forever wars in the Middle East, or to put our service members at risk without end. Our troops are the finest in the world, and I will do everything I can to protect them, including legislative action in Congress to put an end to this war. There is no doubt that the Iranian regime is evil, responsible for killing tens of thousands of its own people and sponsoring acts of terrorism against its neighbors and the United States. That’s why the American people stand in solidarity with the Iranian people in protesting their murderous, authoritarian government. Donald Trump has admitted this is a war aimed at regime change, not just denying Iran nuclear weapons. But it’s worth remembering that Donald Trump ripped up the Iran Deal, which President Obama negotiated — that prevented Iran from getting a nuclear weapon. Now, we will be engaged in war against Iran for a second time in just the last year. So here we are again. I’ll be honest with you... this hurts.
**_I _poured_ my heart into my last message. But maybe I set my hopes too high, Friend. _**
I was _counting_ on people like you. I really thought we’d see a big show of support after my last message... but it just didn’t happen.
**And the truth is, as hard as it is to say, we can’t keep doing the hard work we set out to do without the support to keep going.**
I’m Katie Britt. A mom of two, a proud conservative, and the youngest Republican woman ever elected to the U.S. Senate. I came to Washington to stand up for hardworking families like yours, __not to play politics or sit on the sidelines_._

They’re coming after me with everything they’ve got. They’ve _**lied**_**about me on TV** , _**twisted**_ **my words** , and made me one of their **_top_ Republican targets** all because they know I won’t back down and **_they’re _terrified_ of the fight I bring to the table._**
This isn’t easy for me to ask, but I mean it with _**everything**_ I’ve got:

Tennessee's weapons laws still contain "gotcha" provisions that can turn peaceful, law-abiding adults into criminals based on vague standards or long-past mistakes. Rep. Monty Fritts' two bills--**HB1737** and **HB2514** --offer an overdue course correction grounded in a simple principle: **if the government believes someone is too dangerous to exercise a constitutional right, it should have to say so plainly and prove it --rather than relying on vague offenses and blanket disabilities that ensnare peaceful citizens.**
### When is the vote?
Both bills have been placed on the **House Criminal Justice Subcommittee calendar for Wednesday, March 4, 2026 (9:00 AM, House Hearing Room II).**
They are **Items 23 (HB1737) and 24 (HB2514)** on that calendar.
The calendar runs through **Item 51** , so it is genuinely hard to predict whether the subcommittee will reach them that day.
Even so, **this is the moment to contact members --because bills can move quickly when time opens up, calendars shift, or leadership decides to prioritize an item.**
* * *
## What HB2514 does: end the "intent to go armed" trap for ordinary carry
Today, Tennessee's broad "intent to go armed" concept has operated like a legal minefield: peaceful carry can be treated as a crime based on subjective interpretation rather than any threatening act. **HB2514 deletes the general offense of carrying a firearm (or club) with "intent to go armed," and refocuses enforcement on clear, defined places and genuinely risky conduct.**
Importantly, it **does not create a free-for-all**. It keeps restrictions where they make the most sense--such as **K-12 school buildings and school buses (with specific posting/conditions)** and it **rewrites the "under the influence" handgun offense** to target impairment and risk rather than mere peaceful possession.
In short: **stop criminalizing normal, peaceable carry; keep the law focused on sensitive locations and dangerous behavior.**
* * *
## What HB1737 does: restore rights after debts are paid and childhood mistakes are outgrown
HB1737 addresses a different--but equally important--civil liberties problem: **status-based firearm restrictions** that punish people today for past wrongdoing long after they have served their sentence or rehabilitated.
HB1737:
* **Removes an added "intent to go armed" firearm offense** that applies to people with certain prior convictions (examples listed in the bill summary include stalking and DUI in certain circumstances).
* **Eliminates a special gun disability for adults under 25** based on certain juvenile delinquency adjudications--so a mistake at 15 doesn't automatically mean reduced rights at 24 after years of clean living.
* **Lifts broad restrictions on carrying in public parks and recreational areas** , allowing law-abiding Tennesseans to protect themselves while hiking, jogging, or at a family picnic.

This is the core limited-government point: **laws that target status instead of conduct don 't stop violent criminals; they mainly create technical "process crimes" for people who are otherwise peaceable.** Tennessee can punish threats, assault, intimidation, and reckless endangerment without treating ordinary citizens as presumptive criminals.
* * *
## Why these bills matter for limited government and civil liberties
Together, HB1737 and HB2514 move Tennessee law toward a clearer, more constitutional standard:
* **Replace vague, discretionary enforcement with objective rules.**
* **Reduce victimless, technical offenses that depend on an officer 's guess about "intent."**
* **Judge people by conduct --especially present conduct--not permanent suspicion.**
* **Keep targeted protections for truly sensitive places and truly risky behavior.**

* * *
## If you live in Tennessee this is who you contact: House Criminal Justice Subcommittee
These are the members who may vote if the bills are heard.
**Rep. Fred Atchley (R-12)** - (615) 741-5981
**Rep. Andrew Farmer (R-17)** - (615) 741-4419
